mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Actual Edit colors dialog at 1360x900 scale 1 light, 700x500 scale 2 dark, 360x360 scale 1 dark and 480x360 scale 2 light, with repeated layout. Both 40-point popup rows stay on screen and report selected state. Escape dismisses only the popup, RGB/HSL switching preserves the staged hex string, the acceptance footer stays fixed, and Cancel preserves active color, preferences, document and history.

scope: The RGB/HSL dropdown uses 40-point choices, zero row gaps, inactive hover styling, selected accent outlines and a bounded popup height. Choosing a model explicitly closes the popup. Existing conversion and staged color-adoption policy are retained.
limits: The supplied reference establishes the closed numeric-model control, not a qualified open-menu or color-processing oracle. Native/rendered fidelity and native input behavior remain unverified. No new color model or document operation is implemented.
